crossRefs.note: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
“To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
I myself am Yahweh. Besides me, there is no savior.

There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
translations.bsb: “There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.
translations.kjv: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
translations.asv: There is none like unto God, O Jeshurun, Who rideth upon the heavens for thy help, And in his excellency on the skies.
